title: Verification configuration schemas
responsibility: Defines verification setup, runner defaults, capture-index records and benchmark workload formats.

outputs.name: verifyConfigSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 configuration schema for writing policy, setup, shared links, declared outputs/builds/tools, runner templates, per-file commands and positive timeout.

outputs.name: defaultVerifyConfig
outputs.description: Empty setup/link/output/build/tool/check lists, Bun Vitest/Playwright runner templates and a 600000 ms test timeout.

outputs.name: captureLineSchema
outputs.description: Strict capture-index line schema requiring evidence, kind, state, plain filename and media type, plus optional viewport/provenance/audio/server details.

outputs.name: reportedMeasurementSchema
outputs.description: Benchmark measurement schema before run attribution, including metric/value/method/workload and optional target, samples and comparison context.

outputs.name: benchmarkCaptureSchema
outputs.description: Benchmark payload schema requiring a measurements array; extra object fields are not retained by normal Zod parsing.

outputs.name: workloadSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 workload schema with id, operation/input request, 1–50 rounds and 1–100000 iterations.
